create_orca_header: create ORCA endpoint-load-metrics header in TEXT or JSON format from a list of named metric tuples
get_named_metrics_from_prometheus: get named metrics from Prometheus metrics snapshot and return as list of metric name-value tuples
metrics_header: create ORCA endpoint-load-metrics header by collecting metrics from Prometheus in the specified format
create_orca_header_json: create an ORCA header in JSON format with named_metrics dictionary containing kv_cache_usage_perc and num_requests_waiting
create_orca_header_text: create an ORCA header in TEXT format with comma-separated named_metrics.key=value pairs
